rules.message: The report region must announce politely: aria-live="polite" on #bulk-report (a result the user did not ask to be interrupted by).
Report entries link to rows — every data row needs a stable id (id="row-<id>").
Pre-flight only reports executability — it must not mutate: data-hx-get, never post.
The pre-flight needs the selected ids: data-hx-include="closest form" on the pre-flight trigger.
Answer the pre-flight into the report region: data-hx-target="#bulk-report".
